title: Flat tire
description: You hit a pothole on the way to work and got a flat tire.
You're 2 hours late for your shift.
You spent $%lostMoney% on a new tire.

title: Car breakdown
description: Your car has broken down and you have abandonned it.
You're 2 hours late for your shift and no longer have a car.

title: Sick Day
description: You got the flu and missed %daysMissed% days of work.
You spent $%lostMoney% going to the doctor for a doctor's note.

title: Power Outage
description: There was a storm and you lost power, causing all of your food to go bad.
You spent $%lostMoney% restocking your refridgerator.

title: Heavy Traffic
description: There was heavy traffic.
You're 2 hours late for your shift.

title: Unpaid Phone Bill
description: You didn't pay your phone bill and its service has been disconnected.
You visit the phone store.
There was a long line and couldn't easily remember your account details.
You pay your outstanding balance of $65 and a $25 reconnect fee.
You miss a day of work.

title: Unpaid Water Bill
description: You didn't pay your water bill and its service has been disconnected.
You visit the utility district.
You pay your outstanding balance of $40 and a $25 reconnect fee.
You miss half a day of work.

title: Wage Decrease
description: You employer decrease everyone's pay rate to prevent bankruptcy.
Your payrate was drecreased by $%rateDecrease% per day.
